0022600112.text: The Utah Jazz (1-1, 1-0 at home) host the Los Angeles Lakers (2-0) in the Jazz's third game of the 2026-27 season. Utah sits 8th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, one game back, while the Lakers are 1st in the West and 1st in the Pacific and riding a two-game win streak. Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are out for the Jazz, and Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain) are out for the Lakers. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers won their last meeting 131-107 in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026, part of a 2025-26 series in which the Jazz lost 0-4.
